comment: The RATE jack replaces the RATE knob rather than adding to it: computeBaseSpeed reads baseSpeedFromCv when the jack is connected and never looks at the knob, so a patched cable sitting at 0V holds normal speed and leaves the knob dead. The FREEZE and REV buttons are likewise inert whenever their jack is patched and the matching menu mode is Gated Control, which is the mode both come up in. The knob range and the CV range differ: the knob covers half to double speed across its travel, and the jack covers the same span across -10V to +10V. The FREEZE jack has a second function the panel does not show, and the maker's own tooltip does: crossing below -1V resets the playhead to the start of the buffer. The platter is an OpaqueWidget with no ParamWidget behind it, so dragging it works but no click on it reaches this feature; the same is true of the TD.Scope waveform. The cartridge and scope-spawn buttons carry no printed label.
